mapper.select: SELECT q.id AS queue_id, q.appointment_id, q.queue_no, q.status, q.sign_time, a.doctor_id, d.name AS doctor_name, dep.name AS department, s.visit_date, s.time_period FROM queue q INNER JOIN appointment a ON a.id = q.appointment_id INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = a.doctor_id INNER JOIN department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id INNER JOIN source s ON s.id = a.source_id WHERE a.id = #{appointmentId} AND a.patient_id = #{patientId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM queue ahead INNER JOIN appointment ahead_a ON ahead_a.id = ahead.appointment_id INNER JOIN source ahead_s ON ahead_s.id = ahead_a.source_id INNER JOIN queue current_q ON current_q.id = #{queueId} INNER JOIN appointment current_a ON current_a.id = current_q.appointment_id INNER JOIN source current_s ON current_s.id = current_a.source_id WHERE ahead_a.doctor_id = current_a.doctor_id AND ahead_s.visit_date = current_s.visit_date AND ahead_s.time_period = current_s.time_period AND ahead.status = '等待接诊' AND ( ahead.sort_no < current_q.sort_no OR (ahead.sort_no = current_q.sort_no AND ahead.id < current_q.id) )
